about: I build backends where AI does real work and code keeps it honest. My projects put LLMs inside real systems — a trading engine, a project-management platform, a developer-evidence platform — and spend most of their effort on the parts around the model: schema validation, risk limits, human approval, evaluation, and tests.
I care about systems that tell the truth about themselves: data that is unavailable reads as unavailable, failures are logged rather than hidden, and a track record is kept in git, unedited.
